description: This source file defines the class DuplexPipeStream which is a custom implementation of a Stream wrapping around a PipeReader and PipeWriter from System.IO.Pipelines. It provides asynchronous read/write operations over a duplex pipe in the Orleans security namespace.

classes.name: DuplexPipeStream
classes.description: A custom Stream implementation that wraps an Orleans Pipe duplex connection, enabling read/write operations via PipeReader and PipeWriter.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Releases resources by completing the input and output pipes.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously disposes of the stream by completing the input and output pipes.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data synchronously into a buffer.

methods.name: ReadAsync
methods.description: Reads data asynchronously into a buffer.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data synchronously from a buffer.

methods.name: WriteAsync
methods.description: Writes data asynchronously from a buffer.
